content.short: Publish here your book in NFT format. Be your own publisher, Connecting writers and readers with blockchain technology.
content.description:
Liberada is a digital book platform that uses blockchain to protect copyright and ensure information security. Based on Cardano, the platform allows authors to publish and sell their books in its marketplace, while readers and collectors can easily acquire them as non-fungible tokens (NFTs).

Authors earn a portion of the transactions and receive assistance in promoting their work, while readers and collectors can consume or resell them if their value increases.

In summary, Liberada is an attractive and secure option for anyone interested in the world of digital books. It offers an easy and efficient experience for publishing and acquiring books in NFT format!
